caption: The drawing depicts a loose-fitting garment, specifically a short-sleeved top or nightgown, rendered in pencil on a light, off-white background. The top features a wide, square neckline with ruffled edges and decorative lace trim along the neckline and the edges of the short, puffed sleeves. There is a small button at the center front of the neckline, just above a vertical opening with gathered ruffled trim, suggesting a front closure. The body of the garment is gathered along the neckline, giving it a flowing and voluminous appearance. The depiction is monochromatic, with shading and fine lines used to create the impression of folds and the texture of the fabric. The artist's signature, "Gladys C. Parker," is visible below the garment on the right side.
title: Chemise
